question: Who was the first Indian female athlete to win a medal at the World Athletics Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anju Bobby George**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anju Bobby George** made history as the **first Indian athlete** to win a medal at the **World Athletics Championships**.
 
• She achieved this landmark feat during the **2003 World Championships** held in **Paris**, **France**.
 
• She won the **bronze medal** in the **long jump** event with a leap of **6.70 meters**.
 
• Prior to this achievement, no Indian, male or female, had stood on the podium at the **senior World Championships**.
 
• She was coached by her husband, **Robert Bobby George**, and reached a career-high world ranking of **number 4** in **2004**.
 
• In **2005**, she won the **gold medal** at the **IAAF World Athletics Final** in **Monaco**, a performance that was upgraded from silver after the disqualification of the original winner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PT Usha**:

 
 
• Commonly known as the **Payyoli Express**, she dominated **Asian Athletics** in the **1980s**.
 
• She famously missed the **bronze medal** in the **400m hurdles** at the **1984 Los Angeles Olympics** by just **1/100th of a second**.
 
 
 
• **Hima Das**:
 
 
• Nicknamed the **Dhing Express**, she is a sprinter from **Assam**.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to win a **gold medal** in a track event at the **IAAF World U20 Championships** in **2018**.
 
 
 
• **Dutee Chand**:
 
 
• She is a specialist in the **100m** and **200m** sprints and is a national record holder.
 
• She is the first Indian to win a **gold medal** in the **100m** race at a global event, specifically the **World University Games** (Universiade) in **2019**.
